title: Canonical units endpoint mate calculation
statement: For a morphism f of schemes, the units endpoint equality holds for the canonical units map towerIntegral_unitsSheafPull f, whose adjoint is the chartwise pullback map unitsDirect f.

source.place: Paragraph (2), canonical choice of the units map by pullback along the first projection; expanded using Stacks Tag 00WX

proof.text: Precompose the desired equation with the hom component of comparisonUpperStarCompUpperStarIso. Cancel this isomorphism; its hom followed by its inverse is the identity. The resulting square has comparisonUpperStarCompUpperStarIso.hom on its left side.

Apply the proved general adjoint-square lemma CategoryTheory.conjugateIsoEquiv_symm_hom_app_comp_map_comp from WeilConjectures.WeilSheaf.FieldCoefficientTateTwist. Take the horizontal adjunctions to be the etale and pro-etale inverse-image adjunctions, the vertical adjunctions to be the two site-comparison adjunctions, and the right-adjoint comparison to be lowerStarCompComparisonLowerStarIso.symm. This reduces the square to equality of the transposes of the four endpoint maps.

Unfold the adjunction definitions of upperStarGmSheafToGmSheaf, cartierUnitsComparison and towerIntegral_unitsSheafPull. Cancel each homEquiv against its inverse. Extensionality reduces the remaining direct-image equation to a unit on an arbitrary etale Y-chart. Unfold unitsDirect and the right-adjoint comparison. The latter is induced by identity isomorphisms of the base-changed charts. Both sides therefore pull the unit back by pullback.fst, and their values are definitionally equal.

proof_origin.place: Paragraph (2), canonical units mate calculation; implemented using the existing general adjoint-square lemma and the defining chartwise formulas (K2, 2026-10-28).

lean.statement:
theorem integral_site_pullback_units_endpoint_canonical {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    let κ := comparisonUpperStarCompUpperStarIso AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f
    (κ.inv.app Y.gmSheaf ≫
        (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f).map (cartierUnitsComparison Y) ≫
        towerIntegral_unitsSheafPull f =
      (comparisonUpperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} X).map
          (Scheme.upperStarGmSheafToGmSheaf f) ≫ cartierUnitsComparison X)
